articles.title: U of T's plan to address discrimination against Muslims, Arabs, Palestinians 'insufficient': prof
articles.summary: The University of Toronto's plans to address discrimination against Muslims, Arabs and Palestinians on its campuses are "wholly insufficient," says the author of a report that found the school has a "general pattern of over-policing and under-protecting" these groups.

articles.summary: Alvin Tedjo toppled two political veterans in a hard-fought Mississauga mayoral election, and one of the key promises that helped propel him to victory was a two-year property tax freeze for all residents. articles.title: Trump appeals to state and federal courts to erase hush money conviction
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — A federal appeals court is weighing whether it can — or should — intervene in President Donald Trump’s hush money case now that a New York State appellate court has heard arguments in his quest to erase the historic conviction.

articles.title: 12 men charged in Peel auto theft bust after 96 vehicles recovered from shipping containers
articles.summary: Twelve men have been arrested after Peel Regional Police say they recovered 96 stolen vehicles, worth an estimated $4.5 million, from shipping containers destined for West Africa.

articles.title: Oshawa’s new mayor promises 'new era' at inauguration ceremony
articles.summary: Oshawa’s new mayor Tito-Dante Marimpietri and the rest of city council were sworn in at a ceremony on Monday, held at Tribute Communities Centre, an arena owned by the city in the downtown core.

articles.title: Same teen suspect wanted in connection with 2 fatal Etobicoke shootings: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say the same teen suspect is linked to two fatal Etobicoke shootings this month.

articles.title: Inquest into death of Mississauga man shot by police in 2020 hears from Peel constable
articles.summary: A police constable told a coroner's inquest Monday he was concerned about the risk of an ambush as he approached a car that had crashed into a pillar after it was hit by police gunfire during a botched arrest in Mississauga, Ont., nearly seven years ago.

articles.title: 1 man, 2 children dead in Burlington, Ont., house fire, Ontario Fire Marshal says
articles.summary: A man, a 12-year-old child and a one-year-old boy are dead following a house fire in Burlington, Ont., the Ontario Fire Marshal said Monday morning in a news briefing.

articles.title: A Canada Post mail carrier's last day of home delivery in Toronto
articles.summary: Friday was 60-year-old Anita McCulloch’s last day of door-to-door delivery in Rexdale, her beloved northwest Toronto neighbourhood, filled with people she’s grown to care for over the last 2 1/2 years.

articles.title: Woman, 67, dead after house fire in Oshawa: police
articles.summary: A woman is dead after a house fire at Dorchester Drive Sunday evening, Durham police say.
